thread:
marta: Quick status for Foxglove private/VPC onboarding. Two live blockers: TGW route propagation missing for two child route tables, and KMS decrypt failures preventing our SIEM forwarder from shipping logs. Need owners and short mitigation plan.

owen: tagging network/sre. Which TGW attachment?

marta: tgw-attach-0f1e2d3c. Their terraform created per-AZ RTs and forgot propagate=true on two children. Traceroute from their app box stalls at the transit hop.

sam-sre: copying. I'll run a propagation check script and flip propagate=true where needed.

rachel-csm: Foxglove's SecOps called out that they won't change CMK key policies without audit evidence. They prefer a time-bounded grant for smoke tests.

kevin-ops: forwarder logs show: "AccessDeniedException: User is not authorized to perform kms:Decrypt on resource arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456789012:key/rot-2024". Sounds like alias rotated to a key without grants for rwd-forwarder-role.

sam-sre: plan: (1) patch child RT propagate flags, (2) create a 24h KMS grant for arn:aws:iam::987654321098:role/rwd-forwarder-role to unblock smoke, (3) run forwarder test and share CloudTrail audit evidence with Foxglove SecOps.

integration-bot: scheduled job: tgw-propagation-check for foxglove at 2024-06-27T11:05:00Z.

sam-sre: applied propagate=true on rt-0a11bb22 and rt-0c33dd44. Traceroute from fox-app1 -> 10.110.5.20 now reaches our infra hop.

kevin-ops: creating 24h grant now; will include grantId in the audit payload.

integration-bot: scheduled job: create-temp-kms-grant for foxglove at 2024-06-27T11:12:00Z.

kevin-ops: created grant g-1122aabb (24h). Triggering forwarder smoke.

integration-bot: forwarder smoke test result: 2024-06-27T11:13:50Z Decrypt=SUCCESS, event forwarded to fox-soc-smoke.

rachel-csm: SOC confirmed receipt in fox-soc-smoke. They're asking for a short runbook entry describing the permanent options (key policy vs periodic grant vs dedicated canary key).

sam-sre: will add a runbook section "kms-temp-grant-to-perm-path" with commands, audit steps, and rollback notes. Also opening PR to add preflight checks: TGW propagate flag, route target validation, KMS alias mapping, and assume-role trust.

marta: renewal note: Foxglove utilization 19% of committed capacity last 30d. Flagging renewal risk=medium if onboarding stalls >10 business days. Recommend weekly exec readouts until utilization rises.

renewals: noted; will follow up in 48h and escalate if we don't see perm policy progress.

sam-sre: TL;DR actions: (A) TGW propagate fix applied (done), (B) temporary KMS grant created (done), (C) forwarder smoke passed (done), (D) runbook + PR for preflight checks (in progress), (E) Foxglove SecOps to sign off on permanent CMK approach (pending).

marta: thanks team  updating onboarding tracker and CRM, scheduling exec sync if perm policy not in place by EOD PT tomorrow. End thread.
